XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Injectors

  • Fault: Initially, the engine exhibited sporadic misfires whilst driving and sudden stalling on the road, followed by immediate and smooth restarting. Currently, there is a persistent failure to start: when attempting to start the engine, it turns over normally but does not start.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Malfunctioning injectors

• Action: Check that the injectors are working correctly and, if necessary, have them serviced or replaced.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In this case, overhauling the injectors permanently resolved the fault.
